title: Oily Glazed Argentinian Squid Skewers
description: This dish features tender squid skewers smothered in a floral and silky glaze, perfect for a cozy dinner, and is macrobiotic-friendly by using wholesome ingredients and minimal processing.

ingredients.name: squid
ingredients.notes: cleaned and cut into bite-sized pieces

instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat, making sure it reaches 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, honey, garlic, salt, black pepper, and rosemary to create the glaze.
Add the squid pieces to the bowl and toss to coat evenly with the glaze.
Thread the squid pieces onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush the grill with olive oil to prevent sticking.
Grill the squid skewers for 2-3 minutes per side, or until they are cooked through and slightly charred.
Remove the skewers from the grill and sprinkle with parsley.
Serve immediately, garnished with additional rosemary if desired.
